_how_to_edit: Finished setups for /setups/ideas/ and the home page. s is a Desk Setup Builder state (see data/setup_builder.json for keys and option ids). group picks the section on the page; look is the small label. Optional swap replaces a shop-list row by its label (brand setups), add appends rows; each needs name plus asin (only a confirmed one) or q (Amazon search). After editing run: node tools/render_setups.js && python3 tools/setups_page.py && python3 tools/builder_page.py && python3 tools/home_setups.py
